title: Lively Spicy Moroccan Lamb Couscous Royal
description: A hearty and spicy Moroccan dish featuring lamb, red pepper flakes, and couscous, perfect for a cold day. This kosher-friendly recipe is made with a pressure cooker for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Add the lamb back to the pressure cooker and close the lid.
Pressure cook for 20 minutes, then let the pressure release naturally.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and stir in the chopped dried apricots.
Serve the lamb and sauce over the couscous.
